summary: If the controller `SECRET_KEY` may be compromised, back up the database and run `setup.sh -k` with the same inventory used for backups to generate a new key; a copy of the old key is saved in `/etc/tower/`. Keep external secret systems redundant, since controller can't fetch secrets while they're down.
questions: How do I rotate the automation controller SECRET_KEY?
Where is the old secret key saved after rotation?

answer_card.title: Rotate the controller SECRET_KEY
answer_card.answer_md:
1. Back up the AAP database (`./setup.sh -b`).
2. With the same inventory used for backups:
```bash
./setup.sh -k
```
The previous key is saved in `/etc/tower/`.
